location: English sheet: How to play; End of the game and scoring
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate ice cream starts the first round. Card-flipping turns proceed clockwise.
clarifications: The player with the lowest score starts subsequent rounds.
Capturing a pile can interrupt the turn sequence. The rock-paper-scissors tie-break in the rules resolves simultaneous captures of a pile, not a tie over who starts.
evidenceNotes: The full rendered English sheet was inspected. The first-round ice-cream criterion is distinct from the later-round lowest-score instruction. No printed page number or publication year is shown on this sheet. The capture tie-break was not reused as a starting tie-break.

location: English sheet: Gameplay; End of the round
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently picked a mushroom starts. Turns proceed clockwise.
clarifications: For later rounds, the player to the left of whoever announced the previous round's end starts the new round.
